20.1 Vendor shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer, its Affiliates, and their directors, officers, employees, and agents from each third-party claim and resulting damages, settlements, judgments, penalties, costs, and reasonable attorneys' fees arising from an allegation that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate an intellectual property right.</quote>
<parameter name="rationale">Section 20 meets the preferred position in full. Vendor expressly defends, indemnifies and holds harmless Customer and its Affiliates against third-party claims that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate IP (20.1), and against claims arising from Vendor's breach of Applicable Law, unauthorized access to or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor, and Vendor's gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud (20.2). The procedure mechanics are present and workable: prompt notice, reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying Party's expense, and control of the defence, with a settlement-consent protection (20.4). Customer's reciprocal indemnity is narrow, covering only unmodified Customer-supplied material used strictly as authorized and Customer's violation of Applicable Law, with carve-outs for Vendor Technology, modification, combination or instructions (20.3). Beyond preferred, 20.5 adds procure/modify/replace and refund remedies, and 21.3 makes indemnification obligations Excluded Claims so the indemnity is not squeezed by the liability cap; the fallback 3x super-cap would be less favourable to us and is not sought. No redline required.</rationale>
